entities.name: Thaddée Ntihinyurwa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thaddée Ntihinyurwa,, is a Rwandan Roman Catholic prelate who served as the Archbishop of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kigali, Rwanda from 1996 until his age-related retirement on 19 November 2018. Before that, from November 1991 until March 1996 he was Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Cyangugu, Rwanda. He was appointed Bishop on 5 November 1981 by Pope John Paul II. He retired on 19 November 2018 at the age of 76 years. He lives on as Archbishop Emeritus of Kigali, Rwanda.
